findings.claim: Default small flat single-edge/chain/diamond/cycle executions invoke19 modules, including two different LayerSweepCrossingMinimizer instances.
Default P3 is LAYER_SWEEP/BARYCENTER; default TWO_SIDED greedy-switch adds another same-class invocation before placement for small flat graphs.
Node-only JSON still invokes port ordering, node/label sizing and margin processors; invocation can be a no-op for absent features.
Observed counts: empty0, ordinary connected19, non-RIGHT direction21, self-loop23, two separated components38.
All23 sampled requests preserve full result equality across bundled, PRETTY and memory-instrumented PRETTY with logging enabled.
